options.story:
At 11.00 children brought a variety of food items to offer as annakut to Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. They all gathered and sang thals.

At 7.00 pm the Children’s Day program included prayers, monoacting of Premji Variya and a quiz, ‘Kon Banega Adarsh Balak’. The assembly was capped with Swamishri’s blessings, “The children played a good quiz themed ‘Who will become an ideal child’. Normally one thinks about becoming a millionaire, a president, etc. To become ideal one must have knowledge of our Sampraday, and know of the life and work of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. One reads the Shikshapatri but who wrote it and where was it written? One must know who and where the Bhagwat and Gita were written…”

Home wherever we go

Russi Mody, once CEO of Tata Steel and formerly also head of Indian Airlines and Air India, came for darshan. With him was Shri Aditya Kashyap, chairman of the IIM management institute in Kolkata. Russi Mody is 88 years old, a jovial Parsi gentleman. He came before Pramukh Swami Maharaj and sat on a chair. He had learnt about Akshardham. The cheerful Parsi gentleman asked Swamishri, "Where is your permanent home?"

"The whole world." Saying this, Swamishri raised his hand and made circles in the air with the first finger of his right hand.

"So you have no home at all, is that it? Very good... very good... no worries about any home." The Parsi gentleman laughed freely.

Laughing, Swamishri said, "Wherever we go is home." Swamishri said this with complete detachment. The whole earth is indeed his home! For Swamishri is a world figure.

"Which school did you go to study at?" Russi Mody asked.

"A Gujarati school," Swamishri told him with great openness.

"Do you like Kolkata?"

"There are devotees, so I like it." Swamishri revealed the real secret.

options.story:
At 11.00 am Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of murtis for BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir for the villages of Gamdi, Vaghasi and Parth Township (Jhol). Thereafter Swamishri blessed the assembly.

BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Anand. Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Shri Lakshminarayan Dev. Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj. Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj. Satsang assembly in Akshar Farm. The prominent bhaktas of all three villages also perform arti. Bhaktas perform arti of Thakorji on patotsav day. Bhaktas of Badalpur sing traditional bhajans and play instruments during Bapa's morning puja at Akshar Farm. After his puja Bapa participates by playing 'ghughra' while bhaktas of Badalpur sing bhajans. While Bapa was doing pradakshina of Thakorji the sadhaks sang bhajans and danced like the children of Badalpur.
